page.content:
Cluster of large commercial houses around Times Square in Midtown Manhattan.

How Broadway theatre district connects

  • Topic: Broadway — The theatre district is the geographic body of Broadway.
  • Location: Times Square — The Broadway theatre district is clustered around Times Square.
  • Location: 42nd Street — 42nd Street cuts through the Broadway theatre district.
  • Location: Shubert Theatre — The Shubert Theatre sits on 44th Street in the theatre district.
  • Location: Richard Rodgers Theatre — The Richard Rodgers Theatre stands on 46th Street in the district.
  • Location: Gershwin Theatre — The Gershwin Theatre stands on 51st Street in the district.

What is Broadway theatre district?

The Broadway theatre district is the zoned group of theatres, mostly between 41st and 54th Streets near Broadway and Seventh Avenue, that the League and the Tonys treat as the commercial first class of American theatre.

Key threads lead to Broadway, Times Square, 42nd Street, Shubert Theatre, Richard Rodgers Theatre and Gershwin Theatre.
